recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce the old network backbone to restate the FHIR-32458 cardinality; the later FHIR-32459 model is the current source design and preserves the implementer-facing concern.
issue_request: FHIR-32458 was Published/Persuasive and asked why AuditEvent.agent.network.address was optional when network.type could be present. The accepted resolution made both AuditEvent.agent.network.type and AuditEvent.agent.network.address 1..1, leaving optionality only on the containing network element.
initial_application: Commit e84eb2b6ce8d1a2516c0f0a21e19f78cb7fce143 explicitly applied FHIR-32458 by changing both old AuditEvent.agent.network child mins from 0 to 1 in source/auditevent/structuredefinition-AuditEvent.xml.
additional_context: FHIR-32459, in the same Security block-vote family, later replaced the AuditEvent.agent.network backbone and its address/type children with AuditEvent.agent.network[x] of type Reference(Endpoint), uri, or string. FHIR-32459 is already represented on the combined branch by 3361713448ae61edd34a85a1f02c541eea4278b5. FHIR-32450 supplied related agent-specific network wording.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current authoritative AuditEvent source defines a single optional network[x] endpoint/address value and has no separate network.type child that could appear without an address; fhir.ini maps the old address/type elements to network[x].

related_jiras.note: Later same-field decision replaced AuditEvent.agent.network address/type children with network[x], explaining why the current source no longer has the old FHIR-32458 shape.
Clarified agent-specific network wording and pointed to FHIR-32459 for the network redesign.
